subject: Complaint regarding Parcel Delivery Scam via suspicious URL and WhatsApp message
body:
To,
The Cyber Cell,
National Cybercrime Reporting Portal,

I am writing to report a parcel delivery scam. On [Date and time of incident], I was targeted by a scam involving a fake parcel delivery notification.

Scam Type: Parcel delivery scam

Incident Details:
I received an unsolicited WhatsApp message from the phone number +91 70000 45678. The message contained a threat regarding a parcel return to induce panic and created false urgency with a 24-hour deadline. I was directed to the following suspicious URL: http://indiapost-redeliver.xyz/pay. The scam involved asking for a small payment of Rs 25 to steal banking credentials.

Suspicious Details:
- Phone Number: +91 70000 45678
- URL: http://indiapost-redeliver.xyz/pay
- Amount involved: Rs 25

Red Flags Identified:
- Fake URL (indiapost-redeliver.xyz)
- Unsolicited WhatsApp message from unknown number
- Threat of parcel return to induce panic
- Suspicious domain ending .xyz (indiapost-redeliver.xyz)
- Link is not secure (http): indiapost-redeliver.xyz
- Lookalike domain pretending to be 'indiapost' (indiapost-redeliver.xyz)
- Urgency / threat words (pressure to act fast)
- Courier/parcel fee scam pattern

Loss Details:
[Describe what happened in your words]
Amount Lost: [Amount lost, if any]
Payment Method: [Payment method, e.g. UPI / card / bank transfer]
Transaction ID: [Transaction ID / UTR, if any]

I request you to kindly take immediate action to block the phone number +91 70000 45678 and the URL http://indiapost-redeliver.xyz/pay. I also request you to freeze the beneficiary bank account(s) associated with this fraudulent activity to prevent further victims.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your phone number]
